status: informational research checklist; not legal opinion, automated compliance determination or universal coverage

jurisdictions.name: United States — federal baseline
jurisdictions.law: FTC Act: truthful marketing and appropriate data/security claims; COPPA may apply to child-directed services or actual knowledge of data from children under 13.
checks: Substantiate every measurable feature, antivirus, health, AI, and security claim before advertising.
Document data collection and disclosure practices and keep a prominent current privacy notice.
Evaluate COPPA applicability separately, including verifiable parental consent where required.
Evaluate sector laws, consumer protection, accessibility, state requirements, and breach notifications.

jurisdictions.name: United States — California
jurisdictions.law: CCPA/CPRA and 2026 regulations may apply to covered businesses; specific notice, consumer rights, opt-out, cybersecurity, and automated-decision provisions depend on processing and applicability.
checks: Determine whether the publisher and activities meet statutory applicability thresholds.
Provide notice at collection and a privacy policy when legally required.
Implement applicable consumer access, deletion, correction, opt-out and request-handling mechanisms.
Assess 2026 risk assessment, cybersecurity audit and ADMT obligations where applicable.

jurisdictions.name: European Union / European Economic Area
jurisdictions.law: GDPR privacy/transparency duties where applicable, EU AI Act obligations based on AI system/provider/deployer risk and role, and DSA where the service qualifies as a regulated intermediary.
checks: Identify controller/processor, legal basis, processing purposes, recipients, storage periods, and international transfers.
Provide accurate applicable data subject rights and contact route; implement requests and breach processes.
Classify actual AI function and role; assess transparency duties and high-risk status before launch.
Review child-directed services, consent/cookies, accessibility, DSA and applicable Member State rules.

sources.title: EU AI Act — Official implementation timeline

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom
jurisdictions.law: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act framework, with privacy disclosures and lawful basis required where personal data processing falls within scope; further online-safety and consumer rules may apply.
checks: Identify publisher/controller and provide a genuine contact mechanism before collecting data.
Explain purposes, lawful bases, retention, rights, sharing, and international transfers.
Check UK-specific children's design, cookies, direct marketing, accessibility, and online safety duties as applicable.

sources.title: ICO — What privacy information should we provide?

jurisdictions.name: Canada
jurisdictions.law: PIPEDA may apply to commercial personal information handling, with federal, provincial and sector-specific rules depending on activity and location.
checks: Identify whether PIPEDA, provincial privacy laws, or both apply.
Publish meaningful purposes, consent practices, safeguards, retention and access/correction pathways.
Assess breach records and notice obligations and Quebec-specific requirements when relevant.

sources.title: Office of the Privacy Commissioner — PIPEDA requirements

jurisdictions.name: Brazil
jurisdictions.law: LGPD protects individuals' personal-data rights, including information, access, correction, deletion where applicable, portability and consent withdrawal.
checks: Determine controller identity and a real privacy contact.
Map lawful bases, processing, recipients, transfers, retention and security measures.
Provide applicable data-subject rights workflow and breach response.

jurisdictions.name: Australia
jurisdictions.law: Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles may apply to covered entities, with privacy policy and data handling requirements.
checks: Confirm covered entity status and applicable industry exceptions.
Set out collection, storage, use, disclosures, access and complaint procedures in a current policy.
Review breach notification and cross-border disclosure requirements.

sources.title: OAIC — What is a privacy policy?

jurisdictions.name: New Zealand
jurisdictions.law: Privacy Act 2020 governs collection, use, storage and disclosure of personal information; indirect collection notice IPP3A applies since May 2026.
checks: Identify applicable privacy principles including the indirect collection obligations.
Provide appropriate notice, access/correction processes and security measures.
Review cross-border disclosure, retention and relevant codes.

sources.title: Office of the Privacy Commissioner — Privacy Act 2020 principles

jurisdictions.name: South Africa
jurisdictions.law: POPIA sets conditions for the lawful processing of personal information and regulator oversight.
checks: Identify the responsible party and accountable contact.
Verify processing basis, transparency, safeguards, data subject rights and breach handling.
Assess sensitive data, child information and transborder transfers.

sources.title: South African Government — Protection of Personal Information Act

jurisdictions.name: Singapore
jurisdictions.law: PDPA governs many organizations' collection, use, disclosure, security, retention and transfer of personal data.
checks: Determine PDPA applicability and implement lawful collection/use/disclosure notices.
Appoint appropriate responsibility/contact and provide access/correction procedures.
Use reasonable security, retention controls and cross-border transfer protections.

sources.title: Singapore PDPC — Advisory Guidelines on key concepts

jurisdictions.name: India
jurisdictions.law: DPDP Act/Rules have phased commencement; not every provision became enforceable on the date of notification. Assess the applicable rule and current commencement date.
checks: Verify which parts of the DPDP Act and 2025 Rules are in force on the release date.
Map personal data, notice, consent, request rights, child protections, processor contracts and breach duties as applicable.
Confirm transfer and localization requirements, if any, for the data and sector.

sources.title: MeitY — Digital Personal Data Protection Rules 2025

jurisdictions.name: Other countries, states, provinces and territories
jurisdictions.law: No single disclaimer substitutes for local legal analysis. Privacy, accessibility, consumer protection, children, security, export, AI and regulated-sector rules can differ.
checks: Identify every intended market and the operator's place of establishment.
Check applicable laws, language expectations, rights channels, product claims and required registrations.
Obtain competent local review before collecting personal data or commercially selling regulated functions.

releaseGates.title: Real publisher identity and contact
releaseGates.requirement: Owner supplies legal operator identity, address/required contact and consumer rights channel as applicable.

releaseGates.title: Verified service-specific data practices
releaseGates.requirement: Inventory every module's browser, server, host, cookies, analytics and vendors; document retention, recipients and transfers.

releaseGates.title: Children and vulnerable users
releaseGates.requirement: Separate child-directed offerings, verify relevant age/parental requirements and avoid collecting children’s information until lawful protections exist.

releaseGates.title: Pricing, payments, refunds and tax
releaseGates.requirement: No checkout or billing until price, cancellation, taxes, merchant and refunds are accurate in every intended market.

releaseGates.title: Truthful performance and safety claims
releaseGates.requirement: Do not call policy previews antivirus, suggest perfect protection, medical treatment, or imply certified legal compliance without evidence.

releaseGates.title: AI interaction and synthetic content
releaseGates.requirement: Disclose when users interact with AI; review content labels, provider data handling, prohibited uses and relevant AI Act rules when deployed.

releaseGates.title: Accessibility and localization
releaseGates.requirement: Audit keyboard navigation, contrast, assistive technology and language availability; do not claim WCAG conformance without actual audit.

releaseGates.title: Security, incidents and rollback
releaseGates.requirement: Complete dependency, credential, threat, security, incident/restore tests and vendor review for real release environment.

conceptualVocabulary.creatorExactWords: globally is the world = round and internationally is the earth = flat .. per the bible and all ancient texts
conceptualVocabulary.category: Creator-attributed artistic / religious interpretation; not a geographic, scientific or legal definition
conceptualVocabulary.clarification: In law and ordinary geography, global and international do not indicate alternative Earth shapes. Earth is approximately an oblate spheroid, and ancient texts do not speak with one uniform scientific voice. Jurisdiction depends on applicable law and activity, not the cosmology used in creative writing.
